title: Minimum Due vs Fixed Payment: The 14-Year Credit Card Race
description:
Paying only the minimum due on an ₹80,000 credit card? In our example (36% a year interest), you'd still be paying in 2040.
Run your own numbers free, no sign-up: https://moneyviel.com/money-tools/minimum-due-calculator/

Meet Riya (an example character). She owes ₹80,000 on a card, ₹2 lakh on a personal loan and ₹15,000 on a pay-later bill. We race three ways to pay:
🐢 Lane 1: minimum only → debt-free Dec 2040, ₹1,54,633 interest
🚗 Lane 2: fixed ₹5,000 on the card → Dec 2029, ₹77,019 interest
🚀 Lane 3: same ₹16,800 a month + Avalanche roll-over → Aug 2028, ₹49,346 interest
(Example rates and estimates. Real statements differ because of fees, taxes and billing dates.)
